PRIMARY CRUSHING

PRJC 1108 jaw crusher

Single-toggle crushing technology with hydraulic closed-side setting adjustment and rigid body construction. The manufacturer describes a design with low grease consumption and high production capacity.

Feed opening
1150 × 800 mm
Feed size
750 mm
Brochure capacity
200–350 TPH
Closed-side setting range
100–200 mm
Crusher speed
270 RPM
Power
110 kW

SECONDARY CRUSHING

TEREX TC1300 cone crusher

The secondary cone crusher uses hydraulic cylinder adjustment. The TC1300 handles the secondary crushing stage.

Crusher head diameter
1300 mm
Motor power
225 kW (300 hp)
Maximum feed size
220 mm
Crusher weight
22,000 kg
Brochure capacity
220–320 metric tonnes/hour
PLC control (System 2)
Standard

TERTIARY CRUSHING

PRVI 8250 vertical shaft impactor

Rock-on-rock technology supports cubical shaping and fine-material production, with reduced wear costs and grease lubrication requirements described by the manufacturer. Cartridge options include rock-on-rock and rock-on-anvil.

Feed size
Less than 30 mm
Brochure capacity
200–250 TPH
Rotor diameter
800 mm
Rotor speed
50–70 m/s
Power
187 kW

VIBRATING SCREENS

Separate by size.

Pralcka screens 6018 and 6021.
Equipment nameplates dated September 2022.

Vibrating technology separates materials into grades. The screen design supports easy maintenance and reduced lubrication, with a feed chute designed to reduce screen wear.

Screen 6018

Brochure screen size
6000 × 1800 mm
Screening area

200–300 TPH

Screen 6021

Brochure screen size
6000 × 2100 mm
Screening area
12.6 m²
Brochure capacity
300–400 TPH
Motor power
30 kW
Nameplate speed
960 RPM
